I farm only 6 mu, so I do not play with fancy ideas. I start from what I did before and what the men around me do when they get a steady harvest. On my land, wheat and maize are one after the other, so I keep the ground working and do not leave it idle. I have a well, so I will use water when the crop really needs it, because if I miss water at the key time, the yield drops fast and that loss hurts more than a little extra fertilizer. For wheat, I will use improved seed, put enough base fertilizer in, and give more nitrogen later, because wheat here eats fertilizer and I do not want thin ears. For maize, I will plant hybrid seed like most people do, because it fills the cob better if water keeps up. I would rather put a bit more fertilizer than come up short. My place is not big, so family labor is enough, and I will keep it simple: rotary tillage, a few irrigations from the well, and spray when weeds or insects show up.
